name: Smarter Playlist
description: SmarterPlaylist lets you create dynamic playlists based on rules and conditions (genre, people, ratings, dates, play state, and more). A scheduled task keeps the generated playlists refreshed automatically.

versions.changelog:
## :sparkles: What's New

### :gear: Code or Repo Maintenance

* Stop release notes recommending an install that breaks Jellyfin (#24) @poindexter12

## Installing

**From the plugin repository (recommended).** Add this URL under
*Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories*, then install **Smarter Playlist** from the catalogue and
restart. Updates arrive through Jellyfin's normal plugin update flow.

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poindexter12/jellyfin-plugin-smarterplaylist/main/manifest.json
```

**Manually.** Extract the `.zip` below into its own folder inside your Jellyfin plugin directory —
named the way the catalogue names it, `Smarter Playlist_<version>` — then restart.

> **Delete any existing `Smarter Playlist_*` folder first.** Jellyfin loads every plugin folder it
> finds, so leaving the old one behind registers this plugin twice under the same id. It does not
> fail loudly: the dashboard reports "An error occurred while getting the list of currently
> installed plugins" and configuration pages stop loading, which looks like a broken release rather
> than a leftover directory.

The Jellyfin version this build requires is recorded as `targetAbi` in `build.yaml`.
